title: Trajectory backcast + tiny-team asks (Q2 prep)
body:
Purpose

Short: run a 1-page backcast from our 12-month north-star into a tight set of Q2 OKR candidates and a micro-ask list for tiny teams (pre-all-hands prep). This is a working artifact for exec review + asynchronous feedback.

Context & framing
- Foundational north-star (12m): Make inference predictable and 3x more cost-efficient for mid-market teams while keeping 95th latency SLAs across common request profiles.
- Q2 target horizon (90 days): validate two operational levers that materially move unit economics: (1) autoscaling/burst policy defaults that reduce idle-GPU costs; (2) default cache + batching profiles for webchat workloads to reduce per-token median cost by 18–25%.
- Constraints: hiring runway, Dedicated capacity delivery timelines (onboarding customers in June), and ongoing Private pilot with two regulated customers.

Executive summary (2 sentences)
- Proposed Q2 focus: (A) stabilize cost-per-conversation via default runtime profiles + telemetry, (B) accelerate Dedicated onboarding flow to be self-serve for small enterprise pilots, (C) prepare all-hands narrative that ties short-term ops wins to long-term product-market fit.

Draft OKRs (candidate — please annotate with disagreements inline)
O1: Reduce net per-conversation cost for webchat workloads by 20% (median) while preserving model output quality.
  KR1.1: Ship and enable "webchat default" runtime profile (prefix KV caching + small-batch policy) for top-3 models by usage by week 6.
  KR1.2: Add per-route token-level cost telemetry to Console and default alerts for >15% regression.
  KR1.3: Run 3 A/B prompt-set evals against production traffic to ensure <2% quality regression.

O2: Make Redwood Dedicated onboarding frictionless for pilot customers.
  KR2.1: Reduce Dedicated first-deploy time (trial -> running serving) from 12 days to 3 days (documented steps + automation).
  KR2.2: Publish self-serve Terraform + kube manifests with one-click secrets template and a quickstart guide.
  KR2.3: Close 2 pilot contracts (paid) and capture onboarding friction log.

O3: Align company narrative and readiness for the June all-hands and investor update.
  KR3.1: Finalize a 12-minute all-hands play (slides + 2 demos + 8 min Q&A) and rehearsal plan 2 weeks prior.
  KR3.2: Produce a 1-page customer economics case study (before/after) for one pilot.
  KR3.3: Ship internal playbook for regressions/fallbacks during high-traffic demos.

Tiny-team asks (micro commitments for the 2-week sprint before all-hands)
- Eng-serving-runtime: finalize webchat default profile and flip feature-flag to beta (owner: Diego)
- Console: add cost breakdown line-item and bubble alert toggle on per-route page (owner: Asha)
- Solutions-eng: prepare two customer vignettes (one Dedicated, one Hosted) with measurable before/after numbers (owner: Rhea)
- Marketing: draft all-hands email + registration page + internal pre-read one-pager (owner: Liam)
- SRE: validate fallback playbook for demo environments and rehearse incident simulation (owner: Priya Rao — add to collaborators if available)

All-hands small playbook (short)
- Goal: connect Q2 operational wins to the product thesis (serving-first) and make execution feel tangible for ICs.
- Format: 12-minute leadership segment, 8-minute customer vignette video, 8-minute product demo (pre-recorded + live Q&A), 15-minute breakout waves by org.
- Pre-reads: 1-page north-star backcast, 2 slide decks (metrics + demo steps), 1 pager on the Dedicated pilot timeline.
- Rehearsal: dry-run with AV and fallback recorded demo 4 business days before.

Comms timeline (high level)
- T-minus 14 days: finalise slide deck + pre-read; owners confirm micro-asks done.
- T-minus 7 days: send company pre-read + optional context channel in Slack; release rehearsal schedule.
- All-hands day: open with 30 sec mission reminder, lead into OKR framing, demos, breakouts.

Risk register (top lines)
- Demo regressions: have recorded fallback demos + step-by-step rollback documented.
- Telemetry gaps: if route-level cost telemetry is late, we will surface an explicit "data confidence" flag in the Console and postpone KR measurement.
- Capacity for Dedicated pilots: if infra delivery slips, prioritize one pilot with full QA instead of two partials.

Open questions / decisions needed by Mar 10
- Do we accept a slightly higher latency tail to achieve the 20% cost reduction (tradeoff needs exec sign-off)?
- Which pilot customer is OK to be the public case study? (Legal + Customer Success clearance required)
- Does Billing team approve the proposed trial-to-paid conversion for Dedicated earlier than standard terms?

Baseline metrics (appendix — quick numbers to back the KRs)
- Current median per-conversation cost (webchat canonical workload): $0.082 / convo (Feb baseline).
- Current Dedicated onboarding median time: 12 days (trial->running, Dec–Feb sample).
- Console latency SLO 95th: 120ms internal benchmark for meta-requests; model tail is workload-dependent.

Owners & next steps (immediate)
- Today (owner sync): Diego + Asha + Rhea sync, confirm feasibility of webchat profile and Console changes.
- By EOD Fri: each tiny-team owner posts a 2-line status in #ops-allhands-prep.
- By Mar 10: exec decision on latency vs cost tradeoff.

Notes to self / rough ideas (working)
- Consider a small "demo sandbox" token stipend for pilot customers to run the before/after economics flow (helps story).
- Idea: ship a Console badge "Cost-optimized" that surfaces when route uses default runtime profile + caching. Could help productize wins.

References & artifacts (quick links)
- North-star doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Company+North+Star+2026
- Prior all-hands recording (Dec): https://drive.redwood.ai/recordings/allhands-dec-2025
- Onboarding automation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmaps/pull/27

If you are listed as an owner above, please add brief availability and blockers inline in this doc.
